title: Zelensky Condemns 'Absolutely Unjust' Ally Failure to Warn Ukraine Before Russian Power Plant Strike
detail: Ukrainian President Zelensky publicly criticized allies for what he called an 'absolutely unjust' failure to provide advance warning to Ukraine before a Russian strike on a power plant. The statement underscores ongoing tensions between Kyiv and Western partners over intelligence-sharing and the timely communication of threat information that could allow Ukrainian air defenses to intercept incoming Russian attacks.

title: Ukrainian Soldiers' Starlink Access Restricted in Active Combat Zones
detail: Ukrainian soldiers operating in active combat zones have had their Starlink satellite internet access restricted, significantly impacting frontline coordination and military operations. The restrictions have raised concerns among Ukrainian commanders about the ability to maintain real-time communication and situational awareness during fast-moving engagements, where reliable connectivity is critical for drone operations, artillery coordination, and rapid tactical decisions.

title: Russia Strikes Coca-Cola and McDonald's Facilities in Ukraine as Trump Administration Stays Silent
detail: Russia struck Coca-Cola and McDonald's production and distribution facilities in Ukraine, targeting civilian economic infrastructure. The Trump administration offered no public condemnation of the attacks, continuing a pattern of silence on Russian strikes against civilian economic targets in Ukraine. The strikes represent a broadening of Russia's campaign against Ukraine's civilian economy and supply chains.

title: Musk Says US Government — Not SpaceX — Directed Ukraine Starlink Restrictions
detail: Elon Musk stated that any restrictions on Ukraine's Starlink satellite internet access in combat zones were directed by the US government, not SpaceX. The statement shifts accountability for the battlefield connectivity curbs away from the company and onto Washington, raising questions about the extent to which US policy has constrained Ukraine's use of commercial satellite infrastructure during active combat operations.

media.caption: Musk says US government directed Starlink restrictions in Ukraine

title: Black Sea Emerges as New Conflict Front Over Ukraine Grain Exports as EU Routes Remain Unavailable
detail: The Black Sea has become an increasingly contested new front in the Russia-Ukraine conflict, centered on control of Ukraine's vital grain export routes. With EU overland and river alternatives remaining insufficient or unavailable as substitutes for the volume of grain Ukraine needs to export, the maritime routes through the Black Sea are strategically critical. Russia has sought to leverage this dependency, creating ongoing tensions over shipping lanes, port access, and naval security for commercial vessels.
